name: Trampling Livestock
description: Several ghostly mammoths arise from the floorboards, pawing at the ground in terror before stampeding toward the door.
disable: DC 28 Religion check to exorcise the animals' spirits, or DC 26 Nature check or DC 24 Stabling Lore check to soothe them

offensiveAbilities.name: Sudden Stampede
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The door to the stable opens

Effect The mammoth spirits activate in panic, materializing into physical forms as they stampede toward the door to escape. All creatures standing within 20 feet of the door take 4d10+26 force damage (DC 28 basic Reflex save).
